name: Sister Static
presence: Sister Static kneels in a coat of fiber-optic scraps, mouth moving with a sound you cannot spend yet.

presenceWhen.text: Sister Static watches you as if you passed a test she resents.

greeting: "The machines are in session. Speak, or kneel. I prefer kneel."

hymn.say: "Don't ask me the question. Listen. When it asks what remains, don't be clever. The town is named for the answer, and so is the thing you are hunting."

ash.say: "Save the word for the gate, for the copy of you. He is proud and literal. I am only the hallway."

spire.say: "The Spire is a lung. We have been holding our breath since the flare. If you slot the key, some of us will hate the daylight. Bring it anyway."

say.say: Sister Static almost smiles. "Correct, and early. Say it where the seal can hear you. Have both metals in your hands when you do."

combat.refuse: Your hand passes through Sister Static. She is a broadcast that learned to kneel. The radio hiss rises, unimpressed.
